evidence: Defines consensus parameters for Testnet 5 (BIP 95), adjusting proof-of-work difficulty rules and activating BIP 54 from block 1.
rationale: Adds Testnet 5 (BIP 95) parameters, establishing consensus rules that drop the 20-minute minimum-difficulty rule to prevent block storms and difficulty manipulation. It provides strategically important ecosystem infrastructure for testing BIP 54 consensus cleanup rules from genesis.
